integrity: The counterexample is an exact two-dimensional matrix calculation, while the general repair follows from the complete bounded-right-inverse parameterization of the controlled synthesis operator. The 2019 primary preprint was inspected at the canonical-dual formula for comparison.
scientific_limitations: This finding corrects the operator ordering in one controlled-dual characterization and gives the exact commutation boundary for the published order. It does not assess unrelated results in the article, and an unindexed erratum or informal observation may contain the same correction.
title: Order matters in the canonical term for P-controlled dual g-frames
